segments.spoken: Football is more than the scoreline. Pulse X I turns synthetic match events into intelligence you can inspect, compare and replay.
segments.caption: Football is more than the scoreline. PULSE XI turns synthetic match events into intelligence you can inspect, compare and replay.

segments.spoken: Here a synthetic match replays from recorded events. Every statistic is computed from them, and the screen stays steady while it plays.
segments.caption: A synthetic match replays from recorded events. Every statistic is computed from them, and the screen stays steady.

segments.spoken: Pick a goal and ask why it matters. The evidence drawer shows the calculation and its source events. One moment, three stories: analyst, fan and broadcast director, all citing the same events. The director's cue stays a proposal until a producer approves it.
segments.caption: Pick a goal and ask why it matters. The drawer shows the calculation and its source events. One moment, three stories, all citing the same events. The director's cue stays a proposal until a producer approves it.

segments.spoken: Change the audience or the language, and the wording changes.
segments.caption: Change the audience or the language, and the wording changes.

segments.spoken: Control versus Chaos shows how the rhythm of play shifted, and the pass inspector rates each pass with an explainable heuristic.
segments.caption: Control vs Chaos shows how the rhythm of play shifted. The pass inspector rates each pass with an explainable heuristic.

segments.spoken: In the Control Room, a deterministic engine runs the match on the server. Save a checkpoint, change a tactic, and run a paired comparison against the baseline.
segments.caption: Control Room: a deterministic engine runs the match. Save a checkpoint, change a tactic, run a paired comparison against the baseline.

segments.spoken: Highlights are built only from event data. Each clip shows its score and its source events, with no match footage.
segments.caption: Highlights are built only from event data. Each clip shows its score and its source events, with no match footage.

segments.spoken: Everything is synthetic and rule based, and the Microsoft Agent Framework path is verified offline. The code is public on GitHub.
segments.caption: Synthetic and rule-based. Microsoft Agent Framework path verified offline. Code public on GitHub.
